name: smwmusic-mario-eisouoku-illusionary-blossom-of-cranium-prayer-dioniric-mountainside
title: Mario Eisouoku ~ Illusionary Blossom of Cranium Prayer - Dioniric Mountainside
description:
The stage 2 theme from マリオ永草億　～ Illusionary Blossom of Cranium Prayer.

It's a song that alternates between two different sections, hence the name. Since the lead starts with @5, I tried to make the intro section sound a bit like an old port from 2009, after which the rest of the song comes in full blast.
